en: The postcard displays the image of a neoclassical building with arched windows and large columns at the entrance. Above the entrance, the inscription 'METODISTKYRKAN' is visible, indicating it is a Methodist church. Several people are standing in front of the building. At the bottom left, the Swedish words 'Metodistkyrkan.' and 'Sundsvall.' are printed, followed by a handwritten greeting. The reverse side contains handwritten address information in Swedish and a green Swedish stamp.
